d: Kris turns to Davis for help when a mob enforcer demands that she throw a race  Matt learns that Pete sabotaged his former clubs for the insurance money.
Kris loses confidence in her riding abilities following a racing accident  Junior puts his club on the line in a wager with Bobbie.
Kris, Dani, Matt and Junior find themselves stranded at Davis Farms during a storm  Kerry helps Kris overcome her fear of riding.
Kris must convince an heiress to give Wildfire an invitation to the Breeders' Cup  Dani plots to ruin Kris' plans.
Wildfire competes with Dani's horse Ishmael for a Breeders' Cup slot  Kerry rekindles his romance with Gillian.
Kris must decide between staying at Raintree or traveling to Europe to further her career  Baby Wildfire must be sold.
Kerry's disappearance and a family member's death shake the Ritters  Dani takes control of the Davis ranch.
Kris overworks herself trying to repay the Ritter family for her financial blunder  Matt and Dani compete for a new client.
